:::{#exr-lik-iid}
#### Likelihood of an independent sample

For [mutually independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt)
data $X_1, \ldots, X_n$,
write the [likelihood](#def-lik) $\Lik(\theta)$
in terms of the distributions of the individual $X_i$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-lik-iid}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Lik(\theta)
&\eqdef \p(X_1 = x_1, \ldots, X_n = x_n \mid \theta)
&& \text{(definition of likelihood)}\\
&= \prod_{i=1}^n \p(X_i = x_i \mid \theta)
&& \text{(definition of mutual independence)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
